pl-l4d41c5-d1e118.summary: Defines fornication: though it is the genus of all unlawful intercourse outside one's wife, it specifically means use of widows, harlots, or concubines.
claims: Fornication is generically all extramarital intercourse, specifically with widows, harlots, or concubines.

pl-l4d41c5.summary: Distinguishes fornication, stuprum, adultery, incest, and rape. Fornication, though the genus of all unlawful intercourse outside marriage, specifically means intercourse with widows, harlots, or concubines.
claims: Fornication specifically means intercourse with widows, harlots, or concubines.
